clue.text: Badly written phrase inset that's in brackets

definitions.note: a description: a remark set off in brackets within a sentence

indicators.note: a badly written phrase has its letters jumbled, so the words phrase inset are rearranged

explanation.surface: A grammarian complains that an inserted phrase was clumsily written and sits awkwardly between brackets.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface also describes the answer itself: a phrase inset in brackets.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an aside inserted in a sentence and marked off by brackets is so called; the brackets themselves are also known by the plural.

clue.text: Long time and a bad one

indicators.note: bad means spoilt or wrong, so the word one is reshuffled

explanation.surface: Someone recalls a long and unhappy period of their life.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an era of immeasurable length, an age without end.

clue.text: It's always in reverse

indicators.note: in signals that the letters sit inside the following word reverse

explanation.surface: A puzzle statement that something is always going backwards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in reverse' tempts a reversal, but the answer simply sits within the word reverse, read forwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: both words mean at all times, as in for ever.

clue.text: One needs to cast aside sycophants

indicators.note: cast here means thrown about, shaping the letters of aside afresh

explanation.surface: Advice that a person must get rid of the flatterers around them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cast aside' reads as one phrase meaning discard, but cast is the anagram signal working on aside alone, after the plain word to.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: fawning hangers-on who flatter the powerful are called by both words.

clue.text: They see with audible indications of approval

indicators.note: audible says the following words are to be heard, giving a sound-alike

parts.note: ayes are votes in favour, said yes

explanation.surface: People watch while murmurs of approval are heard around them.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: the organs of sight are the things that see.

clue.text: Fancy taking out a Gemini

indicators.note: out means wrong or disordered, so the letters of a Gemini are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone is attracted to the idea of dating a person born under Gemini.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taking' is a link word; the anagram signal is 'out'.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: as a verb, to fancy something is to suppose or picture it in the mind.

clue.text: One over the eight on the river

definitions.text: One over the eight on the river

parts.words: One over the eight on the river
parts.note: one over the eight is British slang for one drink too many, but here the eight is a rowing crew and one over them is the person in charge of their training

explanation.surface: Someone a little drunk by the riverside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One over the eight' is a British idiom for being tipsy; the eight is really a racing boat crew of eight oarsmen.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: the trainer who oversees a university eight on the water stands over that crew.

clue.text: Tenderising chopped-up cooking components

indicators.note: chopped-up means cut into pieces, so the letters of tenderising are mixed

explanation.surface: A chef tenderises meat and chops up the items for a recipe.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the items that make up a recipe are its parts for cooking.

clue.text: Given a start in life

parts.note: reads like being helped in a career, but literally means brought into existence at birth

explanation.walkthrough: 'Given a start in life' sounds like being set up with money or opportunity; taken literally it is birth.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: being delivered at birth is the literal beginning of a life.

clue.text: The preserve of the do-it-yourself householder

definitions.text: The preserve of the do-it-yourself householder

parts.words: The preserve of the do-it-yourself householder
parts.note: preserve suggests a domain or speciality, but here it is a fruit conserve the householder made personally

explanation.walkthrough: 'The preserve of' usually means the exclusive field of someone; here the preserve is literally a fruit spread.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: a fruit conserve boiled up in one's own kitchen rather than bought.

clue.text: Structure ripe for repair

indicators.note: to repair is to put back together, so the letters of ripe are reassembled

explanation.surface: A building is in such bad shape that it is ready to be fixed.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a jetty built out over the sea is a kind of structure.

clue.text: Gushes from hot fissures

indicators.note: from here means made out of, so the letters of hot fissures are reworked into the phrase

explanation.surface: Steam or water bursts out of heated cracks in the ground, like a geyser.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to pour out or emerge in a flood is to gush.

clue.text: Wise, perhaps, to be direct with staff

definitions.note: Ernie Wise, the comedian, played the feed to Eric Morecambe

parts.note: direct and straight both mean without deviation
to staff a post is to man it

explanation.surface: Advice that being honest and frank with employees is the wise course.
explanation.walkthrough: Wise looks like an adjective but is Ernie Wise, the British comedian who fed lines to his partner Eric Morecambe.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Ernie Wise was the comic partner who fed the jokes, the classic stooge of a double act.

clue.text: They join in operations

parts.note: sounds like people taking part in military actions, but means stitches that close wounds in surgery

explanation.walkthrough: 'join in operations' suggests participants; the operations are surgical and the joining is stitching.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: surgical stitches hold the edges of a wound together during and after surgery.

clue.text: Girl takes Poles round America

indicators.note: round says the two poles sit either side of the abbreviation for America

parts.note: S and N are the south and north poles
USA is the United States of America

explanation.surface: A young woman takes some Polish people on a tour of the United States.
explanation.walkthrough: Poles look like people from Poland but are the two ends of the Earth's axis.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a common female first name stands for any girl.

clue.text: This signal leaves you speechless for a time

definitions.text: This signal leaves you speechless for a time

parts.words: This signal leaves you speechless for a time
parts.note: the busy tone on a telephone line means you cannot talk to the person until later

explanation.walkthrough: The clue seems to describe a shock; it is the telephone tone heard when the line is busy.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: a busy telephone line gives a tone saying the other party is already on a call.

clue.text: Prepares to publish working diets

indicators.note: working means being worked on or shifted about, so the letters of diets are rearranged

explanation.surface: An editor readies a book of working diet plans for printing.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to revise and correct text before printing is to prepare it for publication.

clue.text: Kid will be prosecuted with energy

parts.note: to be prosecuted at law is, loosely, to be sued
E is the symbol for energy in physics

explanation.surface: A child is to be taken to court, along with someone called Energy.
explanation.walkthrough: Kid looks like a child but is kid leather, soft leather from young goats.
explanation.definitionFit: Category: kid leather and napped calf leather are both soft leathers used for gloves and shoes.

clue.text: Flower shown in wall painting miles away

indicators.note: away says the letter for miles is taken out

parts.note: a mural is a painting on a wall

explanation.surface: A flower appears in a wall painting of a distant landscape.
explanation.walkthrough: Flower is a crossword trick: something that flows, a river, here the Russian river.
explanation.definitionFit: Crossword-only sense: a flower is anything that flows, and this is a river in Russia.

clue.text: Single footpad

definitions.meaning: single means only or one alone
footpad, read as foot pad, is the underside of the foot; it is also an old word for a highway robber

explanation.walkthrough: Footpad is an old word for a robber on foot; here it is read literally as the pad of a foot.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym and description: one only, and the underside of the foot.

clue.text: Trust in a woman

definitions.meaning: trust here means belief or confidence

explanation.definitionFit: Synonym and example: belief or confidence in something, and also a female first name.

clue.text: Avoid showing fright when catching ball

indicators.note: catching means holding inside, so the word for ball goes within the word for fright

parts.note: fear is a fright
an orb is a ball or sphere

explanation.surface: A fielder tries not to look scared while taking a catch.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to refrain from or hold back from doing something.

clue.text: As he got found out he was taken prisoner

definitions.note: a person who was seized and held captive

indicators.note: found out suggests exposed, but here out means disordered, so the letters of as he got are rearranged

explanation.surface: A man was captured once his secret was discovered.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: a person seized and held captive as security for demands.

clue.text: Nominally commits oneself to work?

parts.note: nominally reads as in name only, but here means by writing one's name, as when enrolling for a job

explanation.walkthrough: 'Nominally' normally means in name only; here it means literally by putting one's name down.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: to enrol for a job, or register as unemployed, by putting one's name on a form.

clue.text: Request treatment of colitis

indicators.note: treatment here means handling or working over, so the letters of colitis are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone asks a doctor for help with an inflamed bowel.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to ask for or seek something earnestly.

clue.text: It may be taken as an indication of loyalty

definitions.text: It may be taken as an indication of loyalty

parts.words: It may be taken as an indication of loyalty
parts.note: taken suggests interpreted, but a sworn pledge is something one takes

explanation.walkthrough: 'taken as' sounds like 'interpreted as'; in fact a solemn pledge of allegiance is something one takes.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: a sworn promise of allegiance, which one is said to take.

clue.text: Expression of annoyance at which doctor starts

indicators.note: starts says the doctor's abbreviation comes at the beginning, before the word at

explanation.surface: Someone makes an irritated noise that startles a doctor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'starts' looks like jumps in surprise but tells you which piece goes first.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a mild oath of irritation, like damn.

clue.text: Riding-establishment boss

definitions.meaning: a place where horses are kept and bred
a boss is a raised ornamental knob or ...

explanation.walkthrough: Boss looks like a manager, but is a raised knob or button.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym in two senses: a horse-breeding establishment, and an ornamental knob.

clue.text: Boat made by company in Cornwall?

indicators.note: in places the company abbreviation inside the letters for Cornwall's region

parts.note: Cornwall is in the south-west of England, abbreviated SW

explanation.surface: A firm in Cornwall builds boats.
explanation.walkthrough: Cornwall is the county at England's south-western tip; the question mark shows it is one example of SW.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a flat-bottomed barge is a type of boat.

clue.text: Strike by Cupid, perhaps, that could be fatal

definitions.text: Strike by Cupid, perhaps, that could be fatal

parts.words: Strike by Cupid, perhaps, that could be fatal
parts.note: Cupid's arrow strikes the heart in romance, but read medically it is a seizure of that organ

explanation.walkthrough: A Cupid strike is falling in love; the deadly reading is a cardiac seizure.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: a coronary seizure, which a blow from Cupid's arrow to the heart might jokingly be called.

clue.text: Vehicle that goes by road and rail

definitions.text: Vehicle that goes by road and rail

parts.words: Vehicle that goes by road and rail
parts.note: a streetcar runs on rails laid in the road

explanation.walkthrough: It sounds like an amphibious machine, but the streetcar simply runs on rails set into the road.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: a streetcar travels on rails set in the public road.

clue.text: Put on to paper, traditional Chinese style?

definitions.meaning: traditional Chinese script runs in columns from top to bottom

explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the playful second reading: Chinese characters were traditionally set in vertical columns.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom and pun: recorded in writing, and literally inscribed downwards as Chinese text traditionally is.
